description: This file declares functions and constants related to git transaction management in the libgit2 library, including creating, locking references, setting targets, setting reflogs, removing references, committing, and freeing transactions.

methods.name: git_transaction_new
methods.description: Creates a new transaction object associated with a repository.

methods.name: git_transaction_lock_ref
methods.description: Locks a specific reference to prepare for updates.

methods.name: git_transaction_set_target
methods.description: Sets the target of a locked reference, updating its value.

methods.name: git_transaction_set_symbolic_target
methods.description: Sets a symbolic target for a locked reference.

methods.name: git_transaction_set_reflog
methods.description: Sets the reflog for a specific reference.

methods.name: git_transaction_commit
methods.description: Commits all queued changes in the transaction.

methods.name: git_transaction_free
methods.description: Frees resources associated with the transaction.
